Generated Narrative: CodeSystem medication-request-status-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.dha.go.ke/ig/patient-summary/CodeSystem/medication-request-status-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
active ActiveThe prescription is active and can be acted on.
on-hold On HoldThe prescription is temporarily paused.
cancelled CancelledThe prescription has been cancelled. Consider holding before cancelling.
completed CompletedThe prescription has been fully administered or fulfilled.
stopped StoppedThe prescription was stopped before completion.
draft DraftThe prescription is in a preliminary state.
